# Taco John's

> Taco John's is a fast-food restaurant located at 536 N. Main Street in Leominster, MA. The establishment operates under the tagline "Bigger. Bolder. Better."

## Location & Contact
- Address: 536 N. Main Street, Leominster, MA 01453, United States
- Website: https://tacojohnsnewengland.com
